$comment: What a host app must wire up to mount this module. Checked against the code by
scripts/check-host-contract.mjs, so it cannot fall behind what the code imports.
aliasesIntoModule: the host's bundler and tsconfig must resolve these INTO this
module's source. Miss one and the host's build fails on a file that compiles
fine here — which is exactly how the wallet-creation screen stayed invisible on
a live site while every gate in this repo was green.
aliasesFromHost: the host supplies these. This repo ships minimal stand-ins so
it type-checks and tests standalone; a real host points them at its own.
hostMustInstall: runtime dependencies. They live in the host's node_modules,
not this module's, because the module is consumed as source.

aliasesIntoModule.@/lib/cardano: src/lib/cardano/index.ts, and src/lib/cardano/* for the feature builders
aliasesIntoModule.@/lib/keystore: src/lib/keystore/index.ts, and src/lib/keystore/* — the self-custody vault, seed and signing keys

aliasesFromHost.@/lib/api: session-authed API client; this repo ships a plain fetch client
aliasesFromHost.@/lib/toast: user-facing notifications with i18n; this repo ships a console logger

alsoRequired.designTokens: Tailwind tokens the components use: bg-bg1, bg-bg2, text-text, text-text-dim, text-text-hint, border-border-soft, rounded-brand, teal-brand, amber-brand
alsoRequired.locales: copy locales/<lang>/wallet.json and night.json into the host's i18n namespaces; the host's build should sync them rather than fork them
alsoRequired.did: pass the signed-in DID to <WalletHub did={...} /> if the Phoenix custody view is wanted; omit it and that one mode says 'sign in first'
alsoRequired.chainSource: optional, but the web is unusable without it. Default reads the chain from Koios, which a browser cannot reach (see src/lib/cardano/chainSource.ts). Either call setChainSource(network, { kind: 'blockfrost', base }) with your own Blockfrost-compatible endpoint — the platform's Dolos MiniBF speaks that dialect — or set NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAIN_BASE_<MAINNET|PREPROD|PREVIEW> at build time and write no code at all. NEXT_PUBLIC_BLOCKFROST_PROJECT_ID_<NETWORK> adds a key, and a key in a browser bundle is public.
